features.name: Evocation Savant
features.description: Whenever you gain a Wizard level, you can add two Evocation spells to your spellbook for free; copying Evocation spells costs half the usual time and gold.

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.description: When you cast an Evocation spell that affects others you can see, you can protect a number of them equal to 1 + the spell's level; they automatically succeed on their save and take no damage.

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.description: When a creature succeeds on a saving throw against your cantrip, it still takes half the cantrip's damage (if any) and suffers no other effect.

features.name: Empowered Evocation
features.description: You can add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of any Wizard Evocation spell you cast.

features.name: Overchannel
features.description: When you cast a Wizard spell of levels 1–5 that deals damage, you can deal maximum damage. After the first use per Long Rest, you take increasing necrotic damage each time.
